text:
Priya Rao: FYI — Samir from Nimbus (private deployment) reported that some of their engineers couldn't authenticate to the private control plane after our cert rotation last night. Theyre worried this may affect their renewal conversation next week.
Omar Velasquez: Ugh, thanks for flagging. Do we know scope? Is it an expired CA on their side or us? Any 5xxs in the gateway?
Priya Rao: Samir said ~6 developer seats couldn't get tokens; production app traffic was fine. They saw 401s in the control plane audit logs for those user agents. Samir attached a screenshot.
Neha Singh: Quick tech note: during the rotation we pushed the intermediate cert chain that some older client stacks don't accept if they haven't cached the new root. Should be a handshake mismatch (TLS alert 40). We've got a rollback ready but want to minimize blast radius.
incident-bot: Incident OP-2026-29 created (private-deploy-cert-rotation). Priority: P2.
Omar Velasquez: Customer comms: need an immediate status note and a remediation plan + goodwill offer. Nimbus is a renewal at-risk account, high-touch. I'd propose: acknowledge, explain non-sensitive cause (handshake mismatch due to cert chain), confirm mitigation steps, and offer 2 weeks of free premium support + a $500 credit. Keep tone empathetic, avoid technical minutiae.
Priya Rao: Draft short note: "Samir — thanks for the report. We identified a TLS certificate chain compatibility issue during last night's certificate rotation that caused some developer tokens to fail. We have a mitigation in place (see below), and we will follow up with a full RCA and recommended client fixes. Apologies for the disruption. We've proactively applied a $500 account credit and scheduled a private onboarding session to walk your team through the fix." Thoughts?
Neha Singh: Good. Add an escalation path: contact cs+oncall@example.com if they still see auth failures. For mitigation steps: 1) temporarily reintroduce the previous intermediate cert (rollback) 2) publish client compatibility guidance and small patch script 3) schedule forced reissue if customers can't update quickly.
Omar Velasquez: Approve. Priya, please send that ASAP and include expected ETA for rollback. Also record the credit and note renewal team.
Priya Rao: Sending now. Will post copy here.
Priya Rao: Customer-facing message (final):
"Hi Samir, thanks for raising this. We identified a certificate chain compatibility issue caused by last night's certificate rotation that led to token requests returning 401 for some developer clients. We have deployed a targeted mitigation (reintroduced previous intermediate cert to restore compatibility) and are monitoring. If you still see issues, please reply here or contact cs+oncall@redwood.com and we will escalate immediately. As a goodwill gesture we've applied a $500 credit and scheduled a private troubleshooting session at your convenience. We will deliver a detailed RCA within 48 hours."
Neha Singh: I'll run the rollback job and monitor the handshake errors. Command: 
```
./infra/certs/rollback_intermediate --env=private-nimbus --preserve-root=true
```
Neha Singh: Rolling back in 5 min, will tail the control-plane logs and token issuance metrics.
incident-bot: Rollback started (job id: rb-2026-78).
Omar Velasquez: Good. Priya, log the credit in the renewal tracker and ping renewals@ with the note so they can prep for next week's convo.
Priya Rao: Done. Logged credit and pinged renewals. Also set a follow-up reminder for 48h RCA and 72h customer satisfaction survey.
Samir (Nimbus): Appreciate the rapid response. I'll confirm with my team after the rollback and reply here if anything persists. Thanks.
Neha Singh: Rollback complete. Observability: token failures dropped to baseline within ~2 minutes. Continuing to monitor for 20m.
Priya Rao: Posting post-rollback status to Samir in 10m with monitoring update and next steps. Will include the RCA timeline.
Omar Velasquez: Action items for postmortem: add an automated compatibility check for intermediate cert acceptance in our private-deploy test suite, and add a pre-rotation verification task in runbook. Assign to eng-infra for sprint Q3.
Priya Rao: Closing loop here. Final customer timeline: issue detected and initial comm at ~+10m, rollback at +25m, monitoring green at +27m, RCA due in 48h, credit applied immediately. I'll attach the full RCA draft to the customer thread before sending. :white_check_mark:
